C1069.title: Man Sentenced to 3.5 Years for Installing Hidden Cameras in Hotels to Film 51 Couples
keywords: producing selling disseminating obscene materials for profit
C1069.summary: Starting November 2017, unemployed Qian purchased multiple covert recording devices online and installed them in hotel rooms across several locations. He secretly filmed 51 couples engaging in sexual activity, edited the footage, and stored it on cloud drives.
